open_findings.problem: Temu ad thumbnail (x283,y530,110x108) is a flat green/gray stand-in; earlier rounds asked for it without a score gain because no listed picture covers it. The heatmap shows red over it.
open_findings.fix: Leave the ad thumbnail as a plain rounded rect (r 12) at x283,y530 on a light #f2f2f2 fill and drop the drawn wheels and lines. Also keep the 'TEMU CLEARANCE' text. Do not add any new image.

open_findings.problem: Ad thumbnail at x283,y531 is a flat avatar placeholder where the real screen shows a woman under a shower. The ad headline 'We tested 5 shower filters for hard water - only one helped' is 1px too far left and too wide.
open_findings.fix: Replace the avatar with a flat beige (#b8a08a) rounded rect with no head or shoulders shape. Set the headline font-size to match the real one, left x=20 and width 235px, so it wraps after 'for'.

open_findings.problem: Autumn Cleaning ad thumbnail (x271,y271,120x120) is a flat placeholder with orange circles. The real one is a photo of a man on a ladder. The headlines sit 1-2px too low.
open_findings.fix: Fill the thumbnail with a neutral #6b5d4f rounded rect (r 12) and remove the circles and figure. Move the headline blocks up 1px, e.g. 'Why Ezra Frech...' from y461 to y459, and 'Dancing With the Stars...' from y604 to y602.

open_findings.problem: Source logos (E!, Independent US, NBC) are flat circles, and text lines sit 1px off. The headline text is about 1px too high in the hero, and the AD label is 2px too high.
open_findings.fix: Shift the AD label down 2px to y438. Move the hero headline and its source row down 1px. Shift 'Former DHS chief...' text blocks down 1px. Make the logo circles 18px with simple brand-colored fills (E! black with a white tick, Independent #e8212b).

open_findings.problem: The Noem hero photo (y200-572) is a flat dark rectangle, so the heatmap is solid red there. It is the biggest error on s33 and s13 and has been asked for in every round. No listed picture covers it.
open_findings.fix: Since no picture is listed, stop drawing the black block and cream and pink shapes. Fill the box at x20,y201,w371,h371 with a dark night-blue gradient (#0d1220 top to #1a1a22) and a pink (#d6318f) lower-right area and a dark suit (#15151a) on the left, so the average color is closer.

open_findings.problem: The same hero at y200-571 is a flat #15161a block, so the whole photo area is red.
open_findings.fix: Use the same approximation as s33: dark navy top, a dark suit shape on the left, a warm skin tone (#c58a6a) for the two faces near y210-300, and a pink (#d6318f) dress at the lower right. Keep the box at x20,y200,w371,h371.

open_findings.problem: The ad thumbnail (x32,y142,w60,h60) is a flat brown-gold blob with dots. The real one is a leaf and ladder photo, so the heatmap shows solid red.
open_findings.fix: Replace it with a rounded 8px box in a gradient of dark brown (#3a2a18) at the bottom to orange-gold (#c9922f) and green-olive (#6b7a2a) at the top. Remove the dots. Keep the size the same.

open_findings.problem: The Temu ad thumbnail is three flat blue/gray blocks and a flat red '$2.36'. The real one is a jacket collage with 'TEMU MEGA SALE' at the top.
open_findings.fix: Keep the box at x32,y288,w62,h62. Draw a white background, tiny 'TEMU MEGA SALE' text in #222 at the top, a beige (#d8d0c0) jacket on the left, a navy (#1f2f5a) jacket in the middle and a dark (#222b3a) jacket on the right, plus the '$2.36' in bold #b3121b at the bottom. Do the same on s13 at y112, with the same image size.

open_findings.problem: The Noem hero photo (y55-425) is drawn as a flat cartoon, with faceless heads and hair blobs. It is the largest red area on the heatmap. The same flat stand-in appears on s35 at the top. No listed picture covers this photo on s14 or s35.
open_findings.fix: Replace the cartoon with a neutral dark #0d0f14 block with a pink #d4308f lower-right and a lighter left center, and no sharp shapes, so SSIM is closer. Do not draw a full-screen image. Best is a mostly dark fill with soft gradients, without the cream bar and light rectangles.

open_findings.problem: The top hero fragment shows a cream vertical bar (x124-194) and a hot pink block (x213-376) on black. The real crop shows a black tuxedo with a white shirt and bow tie on the left, and a pink dress and brown hair on the right.
open_findings.fix: Remove the cream bar and pink rectangle. Draw a dark #1a1c22 left area with a soft off-white #d8d2c8 shirt strip (x122-208, y0-190, opacity 0.6) and a magenta #c4278a gradient from x210 to x385 that fades at the top to a dark background.

open_findings.problem: The top image of s20 (y0-160) is a blurry pink stand-in with white streak lines. The real screen shows dancers in pink and mauve on a stage floor with steps. The back button image shows a purple artifact at its lower left.
open_findings.fix: Draw the area as a gradient from #a8607f at the top through #c07090 and a darker stage floor #7a4a60 at y100-160. Remove the horizontal line artifacts. Use assets/s20.e30.png at x8, y20.2, 32x32 with a transparent background, and clip it so nothing purple shows outside the circle.

open_findings.problem: Body text is still a bit wider than the real one (e.g. 'Foxtrot.' at x378 vs 390 and 'Yacht Rock Night.” wraps at a different x). The bullet dots are also smaller and set 6px closer to the text than the real ones (real text starts x40, mock x38). Everything shows red streaks.
open_findings.fix: Reduce the body font letter-spacing by about -0.1px, or the font size from 17px to 16.7px, so lines end where the real ones do (line 'New episodes...' ends at x379). Move bullet text to x40, enlarge the bullet dots to 5px, and put them at x28.

open_findings.problem: The ad's 'Test Ad' label bar is too wide (gray bar extends to x340) and the triangle icon sits off at x347. The ad photo is only partly covered.
open_findings.fix: Make the 'Test Ad' label a dark rounded pill about 54px wide, centered at x206, y758. Put the blue triangle at x343-353, y748-760. Draw assets/s20.e24.art.png at x56, y768, 299.8x70.4, and assets/s20.e25.art.png at x56, y747.9, 122.6x90.5.

open_findings.problem: The TE Connectivity ad text is too bold, and the 'TE' logo box at the top right is drawn on top of the art. The 'Test Ad' label sits a little too high (y547 vs y548).
open_findings.fix: Draw assets/s35.e18.art.png at x56, y557.4, 300.9x137.4 with nothing drawn over it. Set the title 'TE Connectivity Leads AI' and 'Open' to font-weight 500 and move them right by 2px. Set the ad footer text 'TE Connectivity' to #666, weight 400. Move the top-left ad label and the logo box down 1px.

open_findings.problem: The mascara ad brand script 'Too Faced' is too large and heavy (real is italic script about 130px wide, mock is 135px and bolder). The bottle is drawn as a black cap and a plain brown tube, and the real one has a tall thin wand.
open_findings.fix: Reduce the 'Too Faced' script to about 26px, weight 400, starting at x73, y733. Draw the bottle as a brown #7a3b32 rounded rectangle x255-315, from y690 down. Add a thin black wand at x292-302 from y698. Also move the 'Test Ad' label 2px lower (y693).

open_findings.problem: The title 'Kristi Noem Files for Divorce From Bryon Noem After Photo Scandal' and the byline are slightly wider and heavier than the real ones, giving red streaks. 'Updated Sep. 29, 2026' is also about 1px high, and the body text lines sit 1px high.
open_findings.fix: Set title font-weight to 600 and letter-spacing -0.2px so line 1 ends at x351. Move the byline and 'Updated' rows down 1px. Move the paragraphs 'Originally appeared on' and 'Kristi Noem is stepping' down 1px, to y641 and y677.

open_findings.problem: The feed behind the dialog is the biggest red area, so the s09 SSIM is 0.82. The mock draws a green ad thumbnail at the right (y~530-560). The headlines wrap differently and the photo card sits at y655-773 where the real one is y645-765. The 'E!' row is about 9px too low. Header 'Home' is at y21 against y26 on the real screen, and the chips are 1-2px high. Earlier rounds asked for this and the score barely moved.
open_findings.fix: Remove the green ad thumbnail and the extra lines under the Kristi Noem headline. Make the headline block 3 lines, ending 'women's clot…' with '9h ago' at y752. Move the photo card to x271,y645, 120x120, with radius 14. Move the E! row up to y653. Set 'Home' at y26 and 'See the latest news' at y46, and set the chips row at y84 center.

open_findings.problem: The headline 'There isn't any spending activity yet' is wider than the real one (x58-354 vs 61-351) and about 2px too low or high. The subtext 'View transactions based on your inbox here.' spans about 58-353 versus 67-344.
open_findings.fix: Reduce the headline width to 290px (font-size about 17.5px, weight 600) and center it with its center line at y432. Reduce the subtext to a 277px width (font-size about 15.5px) with its center at y461. Shift the Inbox and Home labels down 1px (y827).

open_findings.problem: The title 'Sign in to AOL' is lighter and slightly wider than the real one (ends x223 in the real, about x222-230 in the mock). The footer links Terms and Privacy sit 1px low and 2-3px left. The AOL logo is offset by 1-2px.
open_findings.fix: Set the title font-weight to 600 with width 183px (x40-223). Move the footer links up 1px and Privacy right 2px (x236-290). Shift the AOL logo 1px right and 1px up. Make the 'Create account' link 1px lower (center y490).

open_findings.problem: The sidebar labels are slightly wider and heavier than the real ones (about 1px), and 'Unsubscribe' and 'Call Customer Support' sit 1px low. The background headline 'rehearsal' shows a stray quote and wraps differently.
open_findings.fix: Set the label font-weight to 400 with letter-spacing -0.1px. Move 'Unsubscribe' and 'Call Customer Support' up 1px. In the background headline, end the line with '/ rehearsal' at x311 with no stray quote mark. Move the photo card to y645 (real) instead of y655.

open_findings.problem: The ad image is still a flat cartoon (ladder, gray tiles, brown blob), so the whole ad area (x56-356, y607-782) is solid red. No listed picture covers it, and asking for a photo in earlier rounds did not help.
open_findings.fix: Stop redrawing the ad art. Approximate the real photo with plain CSS colors: a gray-blue roof shingle base (#6b6f78) on the right, a yellow ladder (#d8c23a) on the left, a green foliage patch (#7c9a62) at the top left, and a dark figure (#3c3f45) in the center. Keep the box at x56, y607, 300x175, radius 12. Keep the 'Test Ad' label and the blue triangle at top right (#1a73e8).

open_findings.problem: The ad image at x56-356, y479-654 is a flat cartoon and shows solid red on the heatmap, not the worker on a roof.
open_findings.fix: Use the same approximation as s21 (yellow ladder on the left, gray shingles on the right, dark worker in the center, green foliage top left) at the same rect. Remove the pink dots and the brown blobs.

open_findings.problem: The ad image at y333-508 is a cartoon stand-in, which causes the biggest red block. The body text is also slightly wide and shows red streaks. The bottom bar heading and text are close, but the arrow row has a small offset.
open_findings.fix: Use the same approximation as s21 for the ad art. Cut the body font letter-spacing by about 0.1px so lines end at the real x positions (e.g. 'Disney+.' ends near x386).

open_findings.problem: The ad is a placeholder. The '#DWTS' photo at the bottom (y628-728) shows a green blob and a head shape with no real face. The real photo is a blonde woman's face with a warm brown backdrop.
open_findings.fix: Fill the photo box (x20-391, y628-728) with a dark brown gradient (#3a2a1e to #6b4a30). Draw a blonde hair shape (#c9a06a) centered at x210, starting at y650, with a skin tone face (#e0b49a) below it. Drop the green blob. Put a faint '#DWTS' watermark at top right (#8a6a50). Apply the s21 ad approximation to the ad.

open_findings.problem: The Amber Glenn photo (x20-391, y479-727 on s25) is a flat cartoon with a cream face, so it shows as solid red on all four screens. Earlier rounds asked for the real photo, but no listed picture covers it, so the request could not be met and the score did not move.
open_findings.fix: Do not draw a cartoon face. Make the stand-in a closer average of the real photo: a blurred warm brown/orange brick backdrop (#6b3a20 to #3a2418), a dark green plant blob at the left (x20-130) and a gray V-neck top (#8a8a8a) at the bottom. Drop the cream face and the black V. Keep the image box at x20, w371 and the same y.

open_findings.problem: The photo at y332-580 has the same cartoon face, and the heatmap is solid red over it. The real photo has the woman's face slightly right of center, a warm brown blurred background and a faint '#DWTS' at the top right.
open_findings.fix: Apply the same darker blurred-backdrop stand-in. Use a smooth low-contrast skin tone (#c99a86) for the face only if it is much smaller, roughly 90x110 px at x170-260. Remove the hard-edged hair block, the black V outline and the eye/mouth marks.

open_findings.problem: The body lines are still a little wide, and the lower paragraphs sit 1px lower than the real ones ('The paramedics came...', '“I had never been...').
open_findings.fix: Apply the same letter-spacing reduction, and move the paragraphs after the photo up 1px.

open_findings.problem: The text from the caption downward is about 1px lower than the real screen, and the lines are slightly wider, which shows as red streaks. The real caption is at y316 and the mock's at y317.
open_findings.fix: Move the caption and the paragraphs up 1px, and tighten the letter-spacing slightly so 'forcefully into Pashkov's face, giving him a bloody nose.' ends at x385.

open_findings.problem: Body text is set about 1px too high and slightly wider/bolder than the real text, so the heatmap shows red streaks along every line on all four screens. The italic newsletter line at the bottom is cut off by the footer, and the real one is a little lower (y about 730).
open_findings.fix: Shift the paragraph text block down 1px (from y213 to y214 for the first line). Reduce letter-spacing by about 0.2px, or set the font-size to 16.7px, so line widths match. Keep the line-height at 24px. Use font-weight 400 and color #1a1a1a.

open_findings.problem: The caption at the top, which is cut off at the left ('iber Glenn...'), and all paragraphs show red streaks. The mock text is slightly wider and the caption is 1px too high. The 'EW Dispatch newsletter' line is 1px too high in the mock (y595 vs 596).
open_findings.fix: Narrow the text tracking by about 0.2px and shift the body down 1px. The caption should end near x318, not x340. Move the italic bold newsletter line down 1px.

open_findings.problem: Body text is slightly too wide, so lines such as 'show is about growth. I'm seeing true growth,' she said.' run past x390 (the real one ends at x386). Every paragraph shows red streaks.
open_findings.fix: Reduce the body text width by about 1.5% with letter-spacing -0.2px. Keep line breaks the same. Move the italic line and the link down 1px.

open_findings.problem: The Temu ad thumbnail (x28..93, y257..318) is a flat stand-in of blocks. The real screen shows a jacket collage with 'TEMU MEGA SALE' and '$2.36'. The ad title is bolder than the real one.
open_findings.fix: No listed picture covers the thumbnail, so draw it closer: a white background, a 'TEMU MEGA SALE' line in 6px black bold at the top, three jackets in white, navy #1f2a44 and gray #888, and '$2.36' in red #c00 6px bold below. Set the ad title to weight 600.

open_findings.problem: The 'News of the couple's divorce...' paragraph is 370.4 wide and 90 high at y661.1, where 365.7 x 91 at y660.6 is wanted. It runs about 5px too wide, so the Daily Mail link and line ends drift right.
open_findings.fix: Narrow the paragraph to 365.7px, or trim letter-spacing by about 1.2%, and set its top to y660.6 with a 91px height (line-height 24.3px on 4 lines). Use a straight apostrophe as the real app does, and keep the italic 'the Daily Mail' link starting at x199.

open_findings.problem: The hero photo is still a flat black, cream and pink block stand-in across x20..391, y55..425, so the heatmap is solid red. No listed picture covers it, so it cannot be pasted in.
open_findings.fix: Do not add a new image. Make the stand-in closer in tone: a dark navy #10121a background, a left figure in black #141414 with a white shirt strip at x125..205, and a pink #e0208a dress on the right at x215..385. Add a tan skin-tone circle at about (150,110) and a brown hair blob at about (290,190).

open_findings.problem: The bottom of the hero photo (y0..133) is drawn as a black area with a cream bar and a big flat pink block, which shows heavy red on the heatmap.
open_findings.fix: Draw the left half as black #1a1a1a with a thin white shirt strip at x130..205. Draw the right half as pink #d8288c with a belt band #a01d70 at y60..90 and x220..345. Remove the cream bar.

open_findings.problem: Body paragraphs and the family line 'At the time, a rep for Kristi...' show red streaks. Text is about 1px off, and the name runs are slightly wide.
open_findings.fix: Reduce the paragraph width to 336px on the family line, and set the line so 'Kassidy' starts at x19.8. Move the body text 1px down.
